Visual content must be designed strictly according to the specific physical attributes of the product SKU (e.g., texture, shape, gloss, etc.) and accurately reflect the characteristics of the raw materials. Showcase the aesthetic symbolism of the ingredients (e.g., plant components, macromolecules, powders, oils, or micro-textures). Utilize stylized treatments consistent with the product's aesthetics and tone to showcase its inherent beauty. 1. Tone, lighting, and style can be consistent with the [visual tone]. 2. nodes.title: 首帧 + 模板提示词编排

metadata.prompt:
请基于下方 LuxReal 原始镜头模板与首帧参考图，编排可供映雪 image_to_video 使用的镜头运动提示词。
原始模板内容：
A captivating, cinematic narrative style. Visual content must be designed strictly according to the specific physical attributes of the product SKU (e.g., texture, shape, gloss, etc.) and accurately reflect the characteristics of the raw materials. Showcase the aesthetic symbolism of the ingredients (e.g., plant components, macromolecules, powders, oils, or micro-textures). Utilize stylized treatments consistent with the product's aesthetics and tone to showcase its inherent beauty. 1. Tone, lighting, and style can be consistent with the [visual tone]. 2. One dedicated sentence that describes the abstract background (colors, light quality, depth cues, texture) must be included. 3. However, the setting of the spatial environment must not be a specific physical environment (e.g., a studio environment, a room corner, a window, or a specific interior background). Use simple backgrounds and uniform lighting to create an abstract artistic visual effect, conveying the concept of purity and origin. The staticImage of this B-roll must include the following sentence in the last sentence: 'The product itself must not appear in the footage, nor should any form of display stand or base elements be visible. Commercial-grade advertising photography.'.
原始模板文本和首帧参考图已通过画布上游连线接入，不要把原演示视频当作生成输入。
保持主体、构图、材质和动作连续；不要把原演示视频当作生成结果。
